reviews.text: Sadly this isn't great when you are trying to write with a text function, it keeps reverting to pen after each word and it does the same with font size after each word. Given up with it within the hour of downloading
It didn't work well on my phone, but there's also a lot going on. I wish I had more time…so I would definitely purchase it if I wanted it for my ipad and had lots of free time.

Absolutely Confusing and Unresponsive – A Total Waste of Money
This digital planner is an absolute mess. From the moment I opened it, I was overwhelmed by how confusing it is to navigate. There's no intuitive flow, and I spent more time trying to figure out how to use basic features than actually planning anything.

To make matters worse, I had a critical issue with accessing the planner on this account, so I reached out to the seller from another email address hoping for a quick resolution. I never received a single response. It's incredibly frustrating to invest in a product and then be completely ignored when you need support.

If I could, I would return this immediately and never repurchase it. Save your money and your sanity – look for a different digital planner.

The planner itself is a cute design and definitely has the cozy vibes. I was looking for something with a little more personality than my usual digital planner and the home page for this one got me but it’s extremely basic, requires a ton of additional set up, and the monthly calendar page isn’t very usable due to the design. Could be a good planner option for a high school student or someone looking to use this casually if it’s on sale- don’t think this worth the full price though.
